    All Classes and Interfaces

    Classes
    Class
    Description
    Booking
    Represents a booking entry made by a user for a flight and/or hotel.
    BookingManagementService
    Service layer coordinating hotel CRUD, booking transactions, and report generation.
    BookingPanel
    Panel view for managing customer bookings, itineraries, and printable invoices.
    CustomerHashTable
    Hand-written separate-chaining hash table for customer records.
    CustomerRegistryService
    Service layer coordinating User and Customer registration, authentication, and caching via ds.UserHashTable.
    DBConnection
    Handles JDBC connection management for the MySQL database.
    Flight
    Represents a flight entity in the travel booking system.
    FlightBST
    Binary Search Tree (BST) implementation for managing and sorting Flight objects chronologically by departure time.
    FlightCatalogService
    Service layer coordinating Flight operations between MySQL database and the ds.FlightBST data structure.
    FlightPanel
    Panel view for managing and searching flights.
    Hotel
    Represents a hotel entity in the travel booking system.
    HotelPanel
    Panel view for managing and searching hotel listings.
    LoginFrame
    Login and registration view for authentication in the Travel Booking System.
    Main
    Application Entry Point for the Travel Booking System.
    MainFrame
    Main dashboard container frame for the Travel Booking System.
    PackageDeal
    Represents a combined package deal containing a flight and a hotel.
    PackagePanel
    Panel view for browsing and booking dynamic flight-hotel package deals.
    PackageQuickSort
    Hand-written QuickSort implementation for Item 9 package deals.
    QuickSort
    Backward-compatible alias for the Item 9 PackageQuickSort.
    User
    Represents a user in the travel booking system.
    UserHashTable
    Backward-compatible alias for the Item 9 CustomerHashTable.
